content: The Executor successfully handled the HWPX (ZIP-based XML) format by correctly identifying the internal file structure (`Contents/section0.xml`) and performing the required text transformations. Key to the success was the implementation of a robust XML parsing strategy using `lxml` to remove stale layout cache elements (specifically `<hp:lineSegArray>`) within modified `<hp:p>` tags, preventing rendering issues caused by pre-computed glyph positions. The transformation rules for '참석자수' (digit-only), '만족도' (formatted score), and '종합의견' (appended suffix) were all met correctly.
